values.task_boundary: Prepare, then after the exact dependency gate implement only the pure deterministic compiler and its inert ExecutionPlan contract; do not absorb language parsing, execution engine, records, adapters, Runtime, CLI, selector, parity, deletion, or release work.
deliverables: Independent adl-compiler crate consuming the typed adl-language crate
Canonical serializable ExecutionPlan with typed nodes, edges, ports, provenance, source digest, and stable diagnostics
Pure deterministic identity/reference resolution plus composition and pattern expansion pipeline
Versioned domain-separated stable node identity algorithm with golden vectors
Canonical plan fixtures and negative ambiguity, cycle, conflict, bound, and collision fixtures
Equivalent-input permutation, repeated-run, clean-process, identity-locality, and #5339 fixture-map proofs
COTS, dependency exclusion, source LoC, test/fixture LoC, and validation latency evidence
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The compiler consumes only a validated typed adl-language document and returns a typed ExecutionPlan or stable sorted diagnostics without parser, executor, provider, runtime, lifecycle, network, filesystem-mutation, clock, randomness, environment, credential, cloud, or database authority

AC-2: Resolution, composition, pattern expansion, lowering, and topological ordering are explicit, bounded, deterministic, and fail closed on ambiguity, conflicts, invalid cycles, identity collision, or resource-bound violation

AC-3: ExecutionPlan is a versioned inert data contract with canonical nodes, dependency edges, input/output ports, provenance, and source digest, and contains no callbacks, futures, handles, retry loops, runtime policies, timestamps, or host paths

AC-4: Stable node IDs derive from a versioned domain-separated length-delimited semantic preimage and remain identical across equivalent syntax, collection permutations, traversal order, repeated runs, and clean processes

AC-5: Canonical ExecutionPlan JSON and diagnostics are byte-identical across every equivalent #5339 input representation and repeated compilation, while semantic identity changes affect only the required nodes
AC-6: Every applicable landed #5339 positive and negative fixture is mapped; compiler cases pass and non-compiler cases have explicit reviewed classifications with no silent skips

AC-7: Direct dependencies are exactly the landed adl-language crate plus reviewed serde, serde_json, sha2, and hex COTS; incumbent ADL, Runtime v2/v3, C-SDLC, async, HTTP, cloud, provider, database, execution-engine, petgraph, and RNG dependencies are absent

AC-8: WP-05 stays at or below 3500 Rust implementation LoC and 3500 test/fixture LoC, focused warm validation completes within 120 seconds, and complete deterministic validation completes within 600 seconds using /Volumes/FastWork; variance requires exact-revision design amendment and review

AC-9: Product implementation starts only after live evidence proves #5339 merged and retained typed phase closed_out; exact-revision review, typed publication, green required CI, authorized merge, post-merge proof, and typed closeout remain mandatory
dependencies: #5336 architecture, clean-room provenance, ownership, and milestone budget authority integrated
Landed reviewed adl-language public API, schemas, canonicalization contract, and fixture map available on current origin/main
repo_inputs: future landed adl-v2/crates/adl-language public API and checked fixtures from #5339
non_goals: Language model, YAML or JSON parsing, schema generation, and source semantic policy owned by #5339
Scheduling, retry, joins, resume, failure propagation, runtime ports, and execution owned by #5340
Portable records, signing, trust, events, traces, results, and verification owned by #5342
Runtime v2 or v3, provider/tool adapters, CLI, selector, parity, cutover, deletion, release, deployment, or AWS work
Compatibility behavior absent from the reviewed characterization and language contracts
Selecting ADL v2 as active or deleting incumbent compiler surfaces
